mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies adjust to lower revenue expectations.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a month signals a strong supply-side response, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls in the same month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressure despite easing monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases in the same month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a decline in real GDP (GDPC1) during a period of high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate economic stagnation and inflation.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines and CPIAUCSL is above its 12-month average
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 declines and CPIAUCSL is above its 12-month average.
